title: Ask your parish and Vale councillor to shape the Environmental Statement
description: The public cannot respond to the Planning Inspectorate directly during scoping. Ask your parish clerk and Vale ward councillor to press for specific items in the Environmental Statement: field-level land grades, viewpoints from village conservation areas, HGV routes avoiding villages, cumulative assessment with the reservoir construction programme, and battery storage siting and fire safety.
source_label: Vale of White Horse: Cearn Solar Farm page
note: The Vale is a statutory consultee, not the decision-maker. Its planning committee has no vote on the application. Ask it to strengthen its Local Impact Report.

title: Register for Planning Inspectorate and developer updates
description: Register for Planning Inspectorate email updates on EN0110044 and the developer's updates. You can also write to the developer at info@cearnsolarfarm.co.uk or by post: Freepost CEARN SOLAR FARM.
source_label: Planning Inspectorate: Cearn Solar Farm email updates (EN0110044)

title: Join Protect the Vale and ask your parish to engage
description: Join Protect the Vale's update list. Ask your parish council or meeting to engage with the Vale's Oxfordshire Association of Local Councils route for parish input.

title: Respond to the Stage 2 consultation
description: Respond to the developer's Stage 2 consultation, the main chance to shape the layout and cable route. It is no longer a legal requirement but the developer says it will run it. Expected February to March 2027.

title: Register as an Interested Party
description: Register as an Interested Party with a Relevant Representation on the Planning Inspectorate project page within the advertised window after the application is accepted. Only Interested Parties can take full part in the examination.

title: Lobby for strong Local Impact Reports and take part in the examination
description: Lobby the Vale and Oxfordshire County Council for strong Local Impact Reports. As an Interested Party, make written submissions and speak at open floor hearings during the examination.
note: The Vale is a statutory consultee, not the decision-maker. Its planning committee has no vote on the application. Ask it to strengthen its Local Impact Report.

title: Write to your MPs, councillors and the DESNZ Secretary of State
description: Write to your MPs and councillors (see representatives) and to the DESNZ Secretary of State by post. Focus on planning matters: landscape, heritage setting, farmland grades, flood risk, traffic, noise, ecology, battery safety, and cumulative effects.

title: Judicial review
description: Judicial review in the High Court under section 118 of the Planning Act 2008 is available on legal and procedural grounds only. It must be brought within 6 weeks of the decision. This is general information, not legal advice.

title: Note: Vale planning committee rules do not apply
description: The Vale planning committee and its speaking rules do not apply to Cearn because it is an NSIP decided by the Secretary of State.
source_label: Vale of White Horse: Cearn Solar Farm page
